reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 10 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution profile crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source requires a strict left-facing single-eye profile. External-03 still exposes a second green eye/eye rim at the far left edge in addition to the large profile-side eye, producing a three-quarter view rather than the required single-eye profile. Hide the far eye completely and restore the strict left-facing silhouette while retaining the repaired note.
entries.positive_observation: The circular pin/seal is removed, and the note has two compact upper gray-mark rows with no third row and largely blank lower paper. The high bald crown, short dark side/back hair, one dark visible eyebrow and absence of a beard or clearly added eyewear remain. The dark olive uniform retains gold shoulder braid, pale metallic collar patches, one dark-bordered pale neck cross and a compact cluster of breast decorations. The rounded lower head meets a short broad high collar. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque pale warm grey-beige backing and cream note remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The exposed second eye is the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: A possible tiny eyewear/temple detail, individual breast decorations, collar symbols and note lettering are unresolved at source scale; none is an additional rejection reason. The second green eye/rim is directly visible in the native profile crop.
